purpose: Distinguish simple phrase pre-existence from a more informative shift where a legitimate technical statement later becomes an exculpatory explanation for a policy-linked access event.

critical_distinction.simple_precursor: A phrase existed before an event.
critical_distinction.function_shift: The same technical fact or phrase changes role over time, e.g. from neutral operational risk to causal explanation minimizing a policy-control hypothesis.
critical_distinction.why_it_matters: Function shift can be informative even where the original statement was true. It is not proof of pre-planned deception.

ggc_lineage.finding: Russian technical commentary reported GGC shutdown/maintenance loss could worsen Google service quality but explicitly said YouTube should continue operating.
Telecom industry sources described aging/overloaded GGC and Google's direct-peering proposal as mitigation, establishing genuine cache-capacity risk before the 2024 slowdown.

Rostelecom/Roskomnadzor and senior officials attributed YouTube degradation to Google/GGC maintenance and capacity problems while contemporaneous evidence also pointed to deliberate throttling/policy intervention.

assessment.best_current_interpretation: A legitimate technical risk narrative existed before the 2024 slowdown and was later reused as an official/public causal explanation during an event for which independent evidence also indicated Russian throttling. This is a semantic-function shift worth tracking, not proof that the earlier technical warnings were planted.

temporal_precursor_gate.counterexample: Phrase appears only after widely syndicated official/industry reporting; classify as ordinary propagation unless additional coordination evidence exists.

claim_ceiling: TEMPORAL_PRECEDENCE_PLUS_SEMANTIC_REUSE_IS_A_COLLECTION_SIGNAL; IT DOES_NOT BY ITSELF ESTABLISH STATE DIRECTION OR PRE-PLANNED DECEPTION.
